title: The Pressure Weather Convergence

features.name: pressure gauges in rows
features.desc-on-touch: You walk between orchard rows that read like a barometer. Each post hums at a different frequency; together they sing the pressure gradient of the afternoon.

features.name: the field learns to predict
features.desc-on-touch: Grasses here bend in patterns that precede the wind. The ground memorizes weather before it arrives, teaching each blade its next direction.

features.name: the storm's own archive
features.desc-on-touch: A casing half-buried in red earth, its antenna bent by wind that has already passed. The LCD reads NODE ACTIVE but the signal it broadcasts is tomorrow's weather.

features.name: the rising breath
features.desc-on-touch: Funnels of air that spiral upward through the orchard, lifting moisture and pressure toward the next station. The mesh breathes in patterns you can predict once you learn the rows.

features.name: where ascension remembers descent
features.desc-on-touch: A channel cut by pressure and water, now grown over with ferns. The ground here remembers what it released upward; roots reach down toward the released weight.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the paddock when pressure learns to move
narr: You both stood in the field as the pressure dropped.
Leif watched the trees learn which way to bend.
Katita said: the storm doesn't arrive; it's already here,
waiting in the pressure for the ground to remember it's heavy.
The next gust came exactly as predicted.

inscription: here the ground teaches weather how to rise; what was trapped learns to move in rows
